uses.description: El nodo fuente utiliza al nodo destino como componente o servicio

calls.label: calls

has_one.label: has one

has_many.label: has many

belongs_to.label: belongs to

triggers.label: triggers

imports.label: imports

re_exports.label: re-exports
re_exports.description: El nodo fuente re-exporta la interfaz del nodo destino

inference_rules.name: transitive_depends
inference_rules.description: If A depends_on B and B depends_on C, then A transitively depends on C

inference_rules.name: implemented_by_chain
inference_rules.description: If A implements B and C extends A, then C transitively implements B

inference_rules.name: documents_implies_uses
inference_rules.description: If A documents B, then A likely uses B (documentation implies familiarity)

inference_rules.name: calls_implies_depends
inference_rules.description: If A calls B, then A depends on B at runtime

inference_rules.name: imports_implies_depends
inference_rules.description: If A imports B, then A depends on B at build time
